name: Baromancy
description:
Warp pressure gradients in the air — force, not an element. Physical cuts, knockbacks, and dashes. Apply Momentum and Shear to foes. Socket Unleash Momentum and Collapse Shear. Bind an Air Elemental, or become one. A Storm Elemental is the capstone summon.

Train at a Gale Collegium, by using abilities, or by walking.

Every level from 11 onward grants +1 statistic.

Level 30 grants Baromancy Mastery (+10% all attributes; stacks with other combat-branch masteries).
